applicabilityBasis.summary: Open USD is a U.S.-issued, dollar-pegged payment stablecoin issued by Bridge Building Inc. for payments, settlement and treasury use. Open Standard's launch disclosure specifies 1:1 USD mint and burn; Bridge's binding stablecoin terms provide redemption for one U.S. dollar, subject to user eligibility and compliance conditions.

genius.licensingRegulator: FinCEN MSB registration and applicable state money transmitter regulators for Bridge Building Inc. (NMLS #2450917). OCC preliminary conditional approval applies to the separate Bridge National Trust Bank in organization, not the current OUSD issuer.
genius.notes: Reviewed October 7 2026. Bridge's OUSD launch expressly names Bridge Building Inc. as current issuer and separates Bridge National Trust Bank in organization: it is not operational and does not issue OUSD. OCC Corporate Decision 1365 is preliminary conditional charter approval of that proposed bank under Bridge Ventures LLC, not a GENIUS PPSI authorization of BBI or OUSD. Issuer-announced-intent preserves Bridge's public GENIUS-ready group/platform positioning; no current token-specific authorization or confirmed issuer pathway is inferred. Binding BBI terms provide eligible-holder $1 redemption subject to onboarding/compliance, and the dashboard publicly itemizes reserves. Open Standard promises monthly attestations, while the Bridge FAQ discusses quarterly independent transparency reports; no completed monthly OUSD attestation was located, so monthlyAttestationPresent remains false. Bridge EEA supported assets are only USDC and EURC, and Kraken lists Open OUSD among EEA restricted tokens; global exchange marketing does not prove an EU offer. BBI's FinCEN/MSB and state MTL framework and the separate Luxembourg Bridge Building S.A. EMI/CASP permissions are not GENIUS approval or OUSD MiCA permission. General GENIUS DASP restrictions are not yet active; token-specific public GENIUS enforcement was not found in bounded searches, not a clean bill of health for every affiliate.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified issuer authorization, official GENIUS application or foreign registration was located for Open USD/OUSD and Bridge Building Inc. in the stated materials and exact-token searches. This is a bounded public-source review, not proof of legal non-compliance or an assertion that no nonpublic application exists. The SCRC IFR is procedural and legacy trust/MTL permissions are not GENIUS issuer qualification. No token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was located; platform or affiliate regulatory history is not treated as token enforcement.
